submitted.runtimeFlags: SYCL/Level Zero, NEO 26.40; 1 GPU + CPU experts; MTP 4 drafts; int8 KV, 32K of 262K ctx in VRAM; thinking off; 1 request at a time
submitted.notes: Weights: ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF @ ed59f920, IQ3_S in two shards (sha256 of both match the HF LFS ids; shard 2 316b46f3...). CPU + GPU: the most-used experts are cached in GPU memory, the rest are computed on the Xeon 676X from system RAM. Speculative decoding is always on (MTP, 4 drafts per step); the engine refuses --spec 0 for these packs, so there is no non-speculative baseline. Marked lossless because drafts are verified by the full model (engine design); not independently verified. Decode measured at the client per request as completion_tokens / (total time - TTFT), streamed, thinking off, T 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20, max 1024 tokens, over a 10-minute soak rotating five fixed prompts (code fix, function + tests, text-to-JSON, 7.7K-token log summary, 300-word essay). decodeTps is the median request; min/max are the slowest and fastest requests. One Arc Pro B70 (PCIe Gen5 x16) plus the CPU. Per-prompt medians 76.9-126.7 tok/s; draft acceptance 68.1%. Server-reported decode median 87.75 tok/s. TTFT 269 ms is the median for a 37-token prompt. Prompt processing (needle test, uncached): 1,798 tok/s at 7.8K tokens, 2,350 tok/s at 89.6K (TTFT 38.1 s). Card power 226.3 W mean over the soak (at its 230 W limit); CPU power not measured. Evidence: logs, harness, engine config and telemetry at the repoUrl.
